description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behavior, specifically testing the handling of corrupted commits and object integrity checks with git fsck.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines test cases that are expected to succeed, or combinations with 'test_must_fail' to expect failure.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Specifies tests that are expected to fail, used here to verify behavior with corrupted objects.
